title: One-shot luminescence diagnostics for field-scale photovoltaics
mechanism: Device-physics inversion converts one luminescence image into a quantitative power-loss map without multi-condition measurements.
adaptation: Design reference for a power-loss band severity output from one EL image; our cells lack calibrated intensity and electrical data, so no training use.
min_experiment: No training arm; cite in the severity protocol as the physics route for power-loss bands.
evidence: R: 300 modules, relative module-power error down to 0.5%.
